name: CAD Digital
oneLiner: CADD is Tetra Trust's regulated Canadian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against CAD held in trust under Alberta's Loan and Trust Corporations Act.
collateral: Canadian dollar reserves held 1:1 in trust for token holders by Tetra Trust

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: CADD uses an ERC20F implementation with role-gated minting and UUPS upgrades. Ethereum role logs resolve a separate default admin and MINTER_ROLE holder; both appear as EIP-7702-style delegated accounts rather than verified Safes.

controls.label: CADD Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Sourcify ERC20F source shows mint(address,uint256) is onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE); Ethereum role reconstruction found this delegated account holding MINTER_ROLE.

controls.label: CADD default admin
controls.evidence: Ethereum role reconstruction found this delegated account holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Current code begins 0xef0100, consistent with an EIP-7702 delegated account, not a verified Safe.

review.evidence: Sourcify ERC20F source and Ethereum role reconstruction identify role-gated CADD minting through a current MINTER_ROLE holder plus a separate default-admin account.
unresolvedQuestions: Reconstruct Base role holders before treating CADD as fully reviewed across all deployments.
Classify the EIP-7702 delegated-account custody and executor policy for both admin and minter accounts.
Review accessRegistry recipient policy and non-mint operational roles separately.

pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of CADD for CAD through CAD Digital's regulated issuance framework

milestones.title: CADD officially launches as Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin
milestones.description: Tetra Digital Group launches CADD with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, ATB Financial, Wealthsimple, Shakepay, Purpose Unlimited, and Urbana Corporation; deployed on Ethereum, Base, and Tempo.

featuredContent.title: Shopify and National Bank of Canada Are Among Backers of a New Digital Currency
featuredContent.description: Canada's first regulated CAD-backed stablecoin launches with backing from Shopify, National Bank of Canada, Wealthsimple, and others.

notices.title: Active coverage pending
notices.message: CADD launched May 4, 2026 but remains excluded from active runtime surfaces until CoinGecko or DefiLlama publishes usable live price and supply data.
